svg.text: K10 DISHWASHER — bought, turned 90°, raised: washer and clean store
The only washer. The hand opens it with a hook rod; the door folds down inside the cell.
slim 45 cm freestanding, 9 place settings, no 3rd level
hygiene programme: ≥ 70 °C for ≥ 10 min → A0 ≥ 60 (K9b A0 ≥ 90)
used as bought: 0 machine actuators · keys pressed by opto-couplers
FRONT VIEW, right part of the cell (glazed panels removed)
WHY TURNED 90°: the door must open inside the 600 mm depth

g.text: door open over the idle domino and cooker

svg.text: Door opens only when domino and cooker are idle;
the cooker top (z ≈ 1030) sits in a 180 mm pocket
so the door clears it at z ≈ 1060.
Racks pull out along −X onto the open door.
The dishwasher stays a sealed appliance:
opto-couplers bridge its keys, so the Pi
No 3rd-level drawer: it would sit at
z ≈ 1750, out of the hand's reach —
tools go into the lower-rack basket.

g.text: 1/7 The hand catches the door top with its hook rod and folds the door down over the idle domino and cooker
2/7 The hook rod pulls the lower rack out along −X onto the open door
3/7 Pans stand in the rack, tools go into the cutlery basket (the hand cannot reach a 3rd level)
4/7 The rack is pushed back and the hook rod lifts the door shut
5/7 The Pi presses the dishwasher's own keys through opto-couplers: hygiene programme, start
6/7 Hygiene programme: ≥ 70 °C held ≥ 10 min (A0 ≥ 60), checked with loggers on the coldest item
7/7 Shut and dried, the dishwasher is the clean store until the next meal's take-out (P0)
